verdict.rationale: PayPal documents an official MCP server in two modes: a local package run via `npx -y @paypal/mcp` with token and environment configuration, and remotely hosted sandbox and production endpoints (mcp.sandbox.paypal.com and mcp.paypal.com) using SSE or Streamable HTTP transports with client-credential auth. It also documents a broad tool inventory (invoices, orders, disputes, subscriptions, reporting) and quickstarts for wiring the server to Anthropic and OpenAI LLMs in cURL, Python, and TypeScript. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that connecting an agent works as documented (the evidence is first-party docs, the first-party GitHub toolkit, and a docs-existence probe).
